# Dynatech Digitals

> Dynatech Digitals, run by John Adeyemo, helps e-commerce brands build, optimize, and grow high-converting online stores. Services span Shopify/WooCommerce/Wix/Squarespace/Webflow development, TikTok Shop setup, marketplace (Amazon/Etsy/eBay) setup, social media marketing, email marketing (Klaviyo/Mailchimp/Omnisend), and SEO. 300+ clients served, 5+ years of experience.

Dynatech Digitals is a freelance e-commerce growth and web development service. John Adeyemo is the founder and sole specialist, working directly with clients (no account-manager layers) to build stores and drive traffic, conversions, and revenue.

## Services

- [E-Commerce Website Development](https://dynatechdigitals.com/services/ecommerce-website-development): Custom Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, Squarespace & Webflow stores built for conversion. Shopify is the primary platform. Typical delivery in 7 days or less.
- [TikTok Shop Setup](https://dynatechdigitals.com/services/tiktok-shop): End-to-end TikTok Shop setup — account creation, catalogue sync, live shopping, affiliate outreach, and ads.
- [Marketplace Setup](https://dynatechdigitals.com/services/marketplace-setup): Amazon, Etsy, eBay, and Walmart Marketplace account setup, optimized listings, A+ content, and PPC management.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://dynatechdigitals.com/services/social-media-marketing): Paid and organic strategy, ad creative, and campaign management across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.
- [Email Marketing](https://dynatechdigitals.com/services/email-marketing): Klaviyo, Mailchimp & Omnisend flows — welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, and win-back campaigns.
- [SEO](https://dynatechdigitals.com/services/seo): On-page and technical SEO for e-commerce — keyword research, technical audits, content strategy, and link building.
